prior_contract.clinical_safety: No autonomous prescribing, dose change, device control or emergency disposition. Derived output cannot overwrite measured/observed facts; reviewed recommendations and clinical orders are separate.
prior_contract.privacy: Tenant, purpose, relationship, consent/assent, age, jurisdiction, expiry and revocation are checked per record/encounter. Restricted notes and family information are segmented; exports and caches inherit controls.
prior_contract.failure_modes: Wrong patient/unit/source version or revoked permission fails closed. Incomplete context returns an explicit limited/unknown result. Clinical care never waits for automated data completion. Communication failure is visible and requires the configured human escalation path.
prior_contract.acceptance: Preserve every source fragment, stable owner and exactly one alias per source. Reject stale versions, unknown identity/units, unauthorized disclosures and autonomous clinical writes. Verify idempotent events and correction history.
prior_contract.open_gates: Clinical intended-use approval, jurisdiction policy, terminology/profile releases, partner conformance, runtime security and numerical/model evaluation remain open. Documentation adoption does not close them.

profiles.reason: 3061 retains ICU and lifelong follow-up; 3661 adds hypertension/prevention/electrophysiology; 4061 emphasizes ECG/MRI. One profile retains each scope.
Retain specific defect names, single-ventricle physiology, hemodynamics, procedures and explicit adult-congenital transition.
Retain named channelopathies, AV/conduction disorders, bradyarrhythmia, Holter/event monitoring and electrophysiology.
Symptoms, myocarditis, mechanical support, fluid status, hospitalization, transplant evaluation and function are complementary.
Shared familial cardiology context; preserve variant interpretation, counseling, family screening and disease-specific panels.
Educational output, diagnostic assistance, prediction and surgical support are distinct intended uses of shared AI infrastructure.
Retain development, function, anatomy, hemodynamics, progression and surgical scenario models with explicit epistemic status.
Workspace and coordination views share data but retain rehabilitation, research, genetics and ICU interfaces.
Dashboard, clinical core and orchestration layers differ; no duplicate patient stores or mandatory deployment-per-module inference.
933 names immunosuppressants, antihypertensives and diuretics; 4566 adds contrast, multiple nephrotoxins, TDM and missing monitoring.
Shared treatment/session record with distinct PD, HD and CKRT profiles; retain prescription, access, equipment, modality parameters and interruption history.
Retain broad clinical domains plus explicit episode/assessment schema and workflows; local MVP wording does not expand EDHT P0.
Assessment, protective factors, escalation, emergency disposition and follow-up remain human-led; preserve explicit prohibition of autonomous risk determination.
Telecare/transition and element/encounter-level authorization are different responsibilities linked through one consent owner.
Retain developmental/substance/family care, restricted summaries, passport and conditional adult transfer; no universal guardian or school access.
Retain allergy dashboard, immune integration, vaccine clearance, anaphylaxis, immunotherapy and transition across shared owners.
Named SCID/CVID/IgA/CGD conditions plus suspected/confirmed, genetic, infection, malignancy and treatment contexts remain represented.
5002 extends baseline/recovery and multisystem phenotype; retain explicit vaccine-response and test-type detail from 4444.
IVIG/SCIG therapy shares product/route/exposure tracking; retain biological therapy as a separate subtype, infusion reactions, home care and product changes.
Combined-immunity scope and neonatal SCID screening require linked but distinct screening, confirmation, escalation and definitive-treatment states.
Immune safety, antibody-response assessment and post-transplant revaccination are distinct workflows under shared vaccination integration, not duplicate eligibility engines.
Respiratory orchestration retains congenital/airway/rare disease, sleep, home ventilation and emergency/passport interfaces. A common workspace delegates clinical facts and orders to their owners.
One respiratory index preserves bronchoscopy, genetics, oxygen, admissions, ventilatory support and outcomes with source versions.
Asthma profiles distinguish diagnosis, control, exacerbation, trigger inference, allergic context and signed action plan. Preserve biologics, age-appropriate framework and school disclosure.
Retain raw spirometry curves, plethysmography, diffusion/exercise/respiratory muscle testing, quality/reference version and paired bronchodilator administration timing.

CF shares a longitudinal profile while retaining CFTR-modulator eligibility, pancreatic/nutrition/endocrine/fertility context and exacerbation recovery. Molecular interpretation and medication orders remain separate.
Bronchoscopy retains video, lavage, foreign-body removal, diagnostic/therapeutic procedures, sampling, complications and follow-up.
All modalities, historical comparison, signed radiology reports and separately governed AI outputs remain available.
Educational assistance, risk prediction, interpretation and draft summarization are distinct task profiles with pediatric evaluation, review and no clinical writes.
Preserve home spirometry, ventilator/oxygen review, medication supervision, translation and second opinion; do not equate consultation with monitored emergency coverage.
Digestive orchestration preserves hepatology, pancreatic/motility/feeding/intestinal-failure care and nutrition with shared source owners and separate signed plans.
Digestive index retains growth, histology, nutrition, procedure/outcome and imaging references without creating duplicate clinical truth.

Retain IBD-unclassified/indeterminate terminology history, Crohn location/behavior, UC extent, monogenic immune context, growth and instrument-specific activity; no automatic scores or targeted treatment.
Retain named functional disorders and legacy Rome IV reference, evolving framework version, motility testing, continence and patient-reported burden.
Retain capsule/endoscopic ultrasound, therapeutic interventions, images, biopsy location, sedation and complications; image AI is a referenced task.
Preserve organ-specific ultrasound, fluoroscopy/contrast, MR enterography, historical comparisons and report provenance.
Preserve stool parasites/occult blood, lactoferrin/calprotectin context, lipase/amylase, synthetic hepatic function/coagulation and sample/method/time; labs do not themselves diagnose.

Nutrition profiles retain feeding skills, micronutrients, formula/route and fluid/calorie units, PN composition/access, remaining bowel anatomy and adaptation. Orders and pump/compounding actions remain external authorized workflows.
Retain educational output, diagnostic support, nutrition/activity predictions, endoscopy support and draft summary as separate task profiles; no autonomous prescribing.
Nutrition/growth/lab/medication review, endoscopy discussion, translation and family counseling share a consultation workflow, not a feeding-prescription engine.
Systemic disease orchestration retains all organ interfaces, specialty independence, evolving phenotype and adult handover; local MVP wording does not change global adult P0.
Retain subtype, active/limited joint counts, intra-articular procedure history, uveitis and growth, plans and guardian diaries.
One examination/map profile preserves laterality, effusion, tendon involvement, injection/surgery history, gait and observed versus rendered findings.
Systemic and renal lupus assessments are coordinated profiles; retain urinary/blood-pressure/biopsy/complement evidence, organ damage and renal relapse with separate clinical authority.
Preserve electrophysiology, muscle biopsy, swallowing/respiratory involvement, calcinosis and multidisciplinary rehabilitation.
Localized and systemic scope retains vascular/skin distribution, contracture, organ surveillance and change timeline without collapsing disease classifications.
Preserve vessel distribution/size, ocular and other organ contexts, biopsy, damage and recurrence.
Maintain diagnostic classification history and uncertain/evolving overlap phenotype; normalization never forces a diagnosis.
Keep patient/guardian attribution, school and social participation, sleep/fatigue and treatment burden even when inflammatory markers are normal.
Preserve baseline, gait/balance, range of motion, assistive devices, OT/PT/home plan and agreed activity goals.
Medication safety profiles retain pre-treatment screening, glucocorticoid/targeted exposures, organ/infection/vaccination context and clinician-defined treatment holds; alerts cannot execute holds.
One immunization policy profile retains dose sequence, temporary/permanent restrictions, specialist recommendation and expiration/reassessment; expiry is not automatic eligibility.
Shared AI tasks retain pediatric/bias evaluation, source/model version, uncertainty and prohibition on autonomous diagnosis, immunosuppression or emergency treatment.

Precision medicine has broader diagnostic/preventive intent than pharmacology. Keep that as a sibling decision-support profile; retain CYP, OTC/supplements, cross-reactivity tolerance/evidence and no autonomous prescription.

Cardiac patient models retain anatomy/function/hemodynamics/development and surgical scenarios. Operational hospital/physician models are excluded from patient physiology and remain separate pending operational-owner review.

Scientific-execution profiles distinguish human whole-genome/exome/structural variants from pathogen evolution/resistance/outbreak tasks. Clinical report and interpretation authority remains outside adapter execution.
Named protocols and external-system intent overlap the proposed adaptive connector; discovery, mapping/loss review and signed releases extend the existing integration owner.

Retain mortality/morbidity, agency-specific reporting, cohorts, imaging datasets and neurosurgical outcomes. Research education is not cohort processing; anonymous wording needs disclosure validation.

Retraining, clinical validation and knowledge updates are separate governed releases. Preserve approval dates, model/dataset versions, feedback and safety monitoring under shared execution infrastructure.
